title: Knowledge Record Freeze Policy
description: Rules for freezing Knowledge Record content. Specification only.

rules.statement: Frozen records MUST NOT change academic content, assertions, or canonical definition without an approved change request that explicitly unfreezes or supersedes.
record_id remains immutable whether frozen or not.
freeze.status=candidate MAY be used after governance approval pending final Release Manager confirmation.
Unfreeze of an official frozen record REQUIRES Governance Owner approval and a registered change request.
Metadata-only typo fixes on frozen records REQUIRE Technical Reviewer + Governance Owner; academic substance changes REQUIRE full re-review.

allowed_while_frozen: Index path corrections that do not alter record content
Cross-reference registry updates that do not rewrite the KR body
Deprecation / retirement annotations via change request
forbidden_while_frozen: Deletion of the record file to force a new ID
